Class ControllerState

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ControllerState
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActionExecutionState, EndGameState, EndRoundState, EventsState, ExtraMoveState, InitGameState, LobbyState, RecoverState, TotemPickingState, TotemPlacementState
public abstract class ControllerState extends Object implements RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
Base class for all game-phase states in the GameController state machine.

Each concrete state handles the subset of RequestVisitor methods that are valid in its phase; all others throw ServerException by default.

  • Manual states – wait for a player request before transitioning (e.g. LobbyState, TotemPlacementState).
  • Automatic states – transition immediately on onEntry() (e.g. InitGameState, EndRoundState).

After each request, GameController calls getNextState() and keeps calling onEntry() on new states until a manual state returns this.

  • Method Details

    • onEntry

      public ControllerState onEntry() throws ServerException
      Called when the state machine enters this state. Automatic states perform their logic here and return the next state; manual states simply return this and wait for incoming requests.
      Returns:
      the next state to transition to, or this to stay
      Throws:
      ServerException - if entry-time logic fails

    • calcNextState

      public ControllerState calcNextState()
      Computes which state should follow the current one after the last request was processed. Overridden by concrete states that have transition logic.
      Returns:
      the next ControllerState, or this if no transition

    • controlIfPlayerTurn

      public Player controlIfPlayerTurn(VirtualClient virtualClient) throws ServerException
      Validates that the requesting client is the current player and returns their Player object. Only meaningful in manual (non-automatic) states.
      Parameters:
      virtualClient - the client sending the request
      Returns:
      the Player whose turn it is
      Throws:
      ServerException - if the client has no username, is not in this game, or is not the current player

    • formatDeltas

      public static String formatDeltas(String title, Set<Player> players, Map<Player,int[]> before)
      Builds a one-line summary of who gained/lost what during this event. Every player is always listed so an unaffected player is visible too — players with no food/PP change render as "no change". Used as the Game Log message for the EventsTriggered response.
